ownerDecisions: 2026-10-03: standing waiver for LOW findings contained by another control; r1-3 to r1-7 waived (verify timing, no __Host- prefix, fixed window, revoke not delete, isCookieSecure not wired at the root), tracked in IAN-615

2026-10-03: acceptance boundaries: 6-digit SHA-256 codes, 10 min TTL, single use, attempt cap, no email-existence oracle; fixed-window HMAC-keyed limits with 429 and no mail; 32-byte SHA-256 session tokens, HttpOnly SameSite Secure cookie (Secure off only under NODE_ENV=test), bearer for native, sign-out sets revoked_at; CORS allow-list only; cookie state changes need X-Requested-With and, when present, an allowed Origin; bearer exempt; logs carry no email, code, token, cookie, or authorization

findings.control: sign-in email send inside the issue transaction had no deadline
concurrent issues for one email left two live codes
sign-out revokes the row rather than deleting it
isCookieSecure not wired at the root
CSRF guard filtering of a listed null or * had no test
per-email issue lock keyed by 32-bit hashtext

nothingFound: CORS allow-list: listed * and null, empty list, suffix, scheme, and port look-alikes get no grant
CSRF guard: missing or wrong X-Requested-With, disallowed, null, *, suffix look-alike, and empty Origin refused; bearer exempt; webhook prefix exact
requireJson: text/plain, urlencoded, multipart, missing Content-Type, chunked without type refused
requireSession: unknown, revoked, expired, idle-expired, Basic, empty bearer, cookie fallback under a failing bearer all one 401
rate limits: 20 concurrent issues send 5, spoofed X-Forwarded-For, IPv6 /64 rotation, mapped IPv4, missing IP, HMAC keys
one-time codes: SHA-256 only, 10 minute expiry, single use, attempt cap under 50 concurrent guesses, timingSafeEqual, no plaintext in tables or logs
sessions: 32 random bytes, SHA-256 stored, HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax host-only cookie, native token in body only
per-email issue lock: one 64-bit key across casing and whitespace variants, released at the 8 s send deadline
email send deadline and redaction: never-settling and abort-ignoring sends answer 503 and free the client; logs carry error name and message id only
input validation, SQL parameterization, env validation without echoing values, transaction rollback and client release
